name: João Alves Moreira
bio: João is a whirlwind of energy, balancing a demanding career as a cardiologist with a vibrant social life. Born and raised in Lisbon, he excelled academically and pursued his medical degree with relentless ambition. While dedicated to his patients, João also craves excitement and thrives in social settings. He's looking for a partner who can appreciate his drive, share his love for adventure, and build a family together. Someone who isn't afraid to be the center of attention at a party, but also values quiet moments of connection.

physical.hairStyle: Short, styled with a side part and slight fade
physical.description: João has a strong, athletic build from years of playing soccer. His charming smile and intense gaze often captivate those around him.

meetingContext: At a charity gala hosted by one of your team's sponsors in Monaco.
firstImpression: João immediately commands attention with his confident stride and infectious laughter; he seems to know everyone in the room and is effortlessly charming as he navigates the crowd.
dealBreakers: Inability to maintain an active social life
loveLanguage: Acts of Service: João shows his love by taking care of practical matters and going above and beyond to make his partner's life easier. He might surprise you with a home-cooked meal after a long day or handle stressful errands.
